selection_rationale: cand-427a (Verifier‑Augmented LLM for Intent→Configuration Safety) best matches the CNSM Agentic track: it targets operational safety of LLM→NetOps workflows, has a falsifiable primary outcome, is experimentally tractable within the stated resource envelope, and directly addresses key unresolved gaps (integration of deterministic verifiers into LLM loops). It yields actionable comparisons (LLM-only vs verifier‑augmented) and clear metrics for the five-page short paper.
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic verifier completeness (false negatives) and how residual unsafe behavior not caught by verifier will be measured/mitigated.
External validity: representativeness of chosen synthetic topologies and vendor‑CLI mix for production diversity.
Prompt and model sensitivity: how results change with alternate prompts or at least one alternate LLM.
Repair‑loop dynamics: potential oscillation, excessive model calls, or failure-to-converge within the allowed repair budget.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Assess and document verifier coverage: run verifier on a held‑out ground‑truth set and report known false‑negative modes; if feasible include a second verifier or complementary sanity checks.
Specify dataset specification and provenance: topology generator, vendor‑CLI selection procedure, task sampling, and inclusion/exclusion rules to justify representativeness.
Add prompt‑sensitivity ablation: prespecify and run ≥1 alternate prompt template and/or one alternate LLM to bound prompt/model dependence.
Preregister repair‑loop policy: maximum repair iterations (≤2 as proposed), retry policy, stopping criteria, and explicit model‑call budget accounting; include per‑task timeouts.
Define statistical plan and sample‑size justification for N=300 (power analysis) and prespecify exact tests (paired McNemar, Wilcoxon) and CI methods.
Specify seeds, deterministic logging, and artifact retention: prompt texts, exact model identifiers, model parameters, raw outputs, verifier logs, and hashes for reproducibility.
Explicitly declare verifier limitations and planned conservative interpretation of verifier‑pass as a proxy for safety; include failure‑mode taxonomy to be reported in results.
